subject.title: fix(msteams): emit native cjs runtime entrypoints

question: Should `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` be accepted as the package-build knob for publishing msteams with native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The code path is focused, but it adds package build metadata and changes official installed-plugin startup artifacts, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Accept CJS package runtime
options.body: Keep ESM as the default, accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` for msteams, and merge after the type-check blocker plus exact-head package-runtime checks are green.

options.title: Keep the knob internal-only
options.body: Allow this PR only if maintainers are comfortable that `runtimeFormat` remains release-build metadata rather than a documented plugin author API.

options.title: Pause for a different design
options.body: Hold this PR if package format selection should be expressed through a different build or manifest mechanism.

recommendation.title: Accept CJS package runtime
recommendation.body: Keep ESM as the default, accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` for msteams, and merge after the type-check blocker plus exact-head package-runtime checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the package-local npm runtime builder that this PR extends.
